study: FullPool Privileged Student Completion seed42 v2

student_source_state.initialization: fold-specific A1 epoch30 checkpoint for every Student/control in that fold
student_source_state.source_state_caveat: The inherited A1 epoch30 checkpoint was previously trained on all fold-FIT patients, including subsequent FIT-meta patients; FIT-meta is held out only from v2 updates, not from source initialization. This is FIT-only selection but not an independent meta holdout.

teacher_views.rule: use all frozen v1 OOF Teacher contexts for each outer fold; compute context-specific patient-standardized Teacher and A1 margins; average each context's KD loss weighted by its inherited target-cell multiplicity, summing to 13 per fold
teacher_views.reason: v1 has 17 source contexts for 65 cells, whereas v2 specifies one shared Student per outer fold; this preserves all frozen Teacher views without selecting a context by new target outcome
teacher_views.reliability_gain: FIT-patient context-weighted mean OOF Teacher AP minus corresponding A1 AP
teacher_views.weighted_D3_patient_weight: clip(reliability_gain, 0, 0.2), then divide by mean positive clipped weight over Student-train patients; if all zero, stop weighted variant as noninformative

fit_meta_split.rule: sort fold-FIT patient IDs by SHA256(seed|fold|patient_id|student_meta); first ceil(0.2*N) are meta-validation, remainder Student-train
fit_meta_split.meta_labels_used_for: Student hyperparameter/epoch selection and posthoc diagnostics only

training.hard_label_loss: exact A1 patient-equal weighted BCE with EZ:NEZ 2:1
training.rationale_for_fixed_ratio: protocol permits fixing r=0.1 when full grid is computationally excessive
training.selection: FIT-meta patient-equal EZ-AP, then MRR, Top1, lower KD weight; epoch0 is legal
training.early_stopping: after epoch5, patience6 on FIT-meta EZ-AP; never exceed 30 epochs
training.candidate_schedule: FIT-only successive halving: train all 12 tau/lambda candidates to epoch2, top3 by FIT-meta selection to epoch8, top1 to epoch30; D0+ trained to epoch30 under same optimizer/batch/selection rule
training.D4_loss: hard-label BCE + lambda * (0.5 * pairwise_KL + 0.5 * listwise_KL) with the same tau/lambda grid
training.normalization: reuse the exact A1 full fold-FIT normalizer associated with the inherited A1 source checkpoint; construct a patient Subset so only Student-train IDs receive v2 gradient updates
training.discriminative_groups: upper=channel_classifier, seizure_aggregator, final_norm; lower=b0_encoder, temporal_encoder, m1_norm
training.D4_gate: run D4 on all folds only when the five-fold mean FIT-meta AP of selected D1 or D2 exceeds matched D0+; do not inspect target outcomes

target_scoring.threshold_for_secondary_classification_m: fixed NEZ probability 0.5 for all v2 Students; no target calibration

limitations_predeclared: v1 has no historical per-file SHA256 manifest, so byte-for-byte comparison to a v1-era manifest is impossible; numerical target replay is exact and a v2 pretraining input manifest is hash-locked
FIT-meta was used during inherited A1 source training; it is not an independent unseen meta cohort
v1 context membership derives from inherited A1 VLOO selection, which used other validation patients' labels; no new Student target labels are used for fitting or selection
successive halving can miss late-improving hyperparameters and must be reported as an efficiency limitation
